name: Tag Pairings
changes: When the settings refuse a Pro choice, for example in Count only this folder, the keyboard focus now stays on that setting.
tip: Type a tag and a space to see related tags. Shift+Enter adds one, and the list opens again. Enter, and Tab on a list item line, add a tag only after Up or Down.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Tag Pairings is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
